hint.zh: 要证的「门锁着」里没有 ¬。先想想怎样得到「¬¬门锁着」。
hint.en: The goal, “the door is locked”, has no ¬ in it. First think how to get “¬¬the door is locked”.

hint.zh: 和<level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>一样用框，只是这次假设「¬门锁着」。
hint.en: Use a box as in <level-ref to="notI"></level-ref>, only this time assume “¬the door is locked”.

t.zh: 「假设门没锁，就会推出矛盾，所以门锁着。」这是反证法。
t.en: “Suppose the door is not locked; that leads to a contradiction; so it is locked.” This is proof by contradiction.
